# 🚀 Getting Started with ConfigKit
### Your digital workspace, all in one place

# 👋 Welcome to ConfigKit

**One platform. Lots of possibilities.**

- A collection of useful digital tools and workspaces
- Organise files, documents and everyday tasks
- Create, customise and share
- Explore at your own pace

# 🔐 Step 1: Set Up Your Account

Your account is your gateway to ConfigKit.

- Sign in using your available sign-in method
- Set up a passkey where supported
- Enable two-factor authentication
- Store your recovery codes somewhere safe

**Tip:** Never share your passwords or recovery codes.

# 📁 Step 2: Explore ConfigKit Drive

Your space for files and documents.

- Upload and organise files
- Create folders
- Store documents and other work
- Preview and download your files
- Use temporary sharing links when available

**Keep everything organised and easy to find.**

# 📝 Step 3: Create Your First Document

Meet Docs & Slides Studio!

- Write notes, guides and longer documents
- Format your content
- Save your work to ConfigKit Drive
- Load documents when you need them
- Share saved work using available sharing options

**Your ideas deserve a place to grow.**

# 📊 Step 4: Make Your First Presentation

Use the Slides Studio to bring your ideas to life.

- Create a presentation
- Add titles and key points
- Organise information into slides
- Save your presentation to Drive
- Share your saved slides when ready

**Start simple. Make it yours.**

# 🗓️ Step 5: Organise Your Day

ConfigKit includes tools to help you stay on track.

- Daily Planner – organise your tasks
- Notes & Ideas – capture thoughts
- Habit Tracker – build helpful routines
- Personal Insights – explore your activity

**Small steps can make a big difference.**

# ✨ Step 6: Discover More Features

There is plenty more to explore!

- Mobileconfig Studio and Web Clip Builder
- Document Vault and Projects
- Community, Groups and publishing tools
- Kids Zone and Family Dashboard
- Education Dashboard
- Creative studios and Security Centre

Feature access may depend on your account and permissions.

# 🛡️ Step 7: Share Safely

Before sharing anything:

- Check the contents of your document
- Remove private or sensitive information
- Review who can access the link
- Remember that temporary links can expire
- Never share account credentials

**Your privacy matters.**

# 🎉 You're Ready to Explore!

You've taken your first steps with ConfigKit.

**Create. Organise. Discover. Connect.**

Explore the tools, find what works for you, and make ConfigKit your own.

### Welcome aboard! 💚
